name: offplan-sa-registry
description: Browse and compare Saudi off-plan real-estate projects using Off Plan's public project registry, developer information and approved project photos, when available. No Off Plan account is required to explore public data.

interface.longDescription: Explore Saudi off-plan projects through Off Plan. Search by city, district, developer or project, compare published project details, and browse approved photos and brochure facts where available. Projects display public location, status and delivery information, with prices only when sourced from published materials. Advertised prices are not guaranteed live offers; availability and final pricing require confirmation with the developer. International buyers may explore projects and learn which foreign-ownership requirements need checking with official authorities. Browsing does not require an Off Plan account. To register interest or contact a developer, follow the official project link to offplan.sa and submit the website form yourself with consent. The plugin does not submit bookings or collect payments.
capabilities: Explore developer profiles and brochure facts
defaultPrompt: اعرض مشاريع متنوعة من أسس وزود ورتال في الرياض، مع الأسعار المنشورة إن توفرت.
قارن بين ريجان هيلز ورويا سدرة وأيالا المحمدية من رتال من حيث الموقع والمواصفات.
I am a foreign investor. Show Saudi off-plan projects I can explore and explain what ownership rules I should verify.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.2 diversifies reviewer examples across OSUS, Zood and Retal, project comparisons, approved image galleries, international investors and live inventory. Negative cases test out-of-scope stock prices, financing calculations and careers. Public MCP configuration and original logo are unchanged.

positive.description: Search across several Saudi developers (OSUS, Zood and Retal), showing only sourced project details and any verified published prices.
positive.prompt: اعرض مشاريع متنوعة من أسس وزود ورتال في الرياض، مع أسعارها المنشورة إن وجدت وروابط صفحاتها.
positive.expected_behavior: Find real projects associated with each requested developer, using search_projects and get_project as needed; present a diverse set of available matches and canonical Off Plan project links. Where published, quote only project facts and document-backed advertised prices using get_project_document_facts and identify document title/page when available. If a developer has no confirmed matching project, or no published price, explain this without inventing listings, figures, or current unit availability. Prefer Arabic for the user response.

positive.description: Compare three named Retal projects using their actual public information, without inventing prices or delivery dates.
positive.prompt: قارن بين ريجان هيلز ورويا سدرة وأيالا المحمدية من رتال من حيث الموقع والمواصفات والأسعار المنشورة.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve each project precisely with search_projects and retrieve their individual public records using get_project. Provide a structured comparison of location, property type, features and project status where available. Show pricing, handover and amenities only when present in authoritative project records; explicitly label missing or unverified values. Provide correct official Off Plan project page links and do not invent numerical investment returns.

positive.description: Show the approved project photographs of Zood Elevee using the linked visual project gallery.
positive.prompt: اعرض صور مشروع إلوڤي من زود.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact Elevee/إلوڤي project from Zood, call get_project, and use only approved cover_image_url and image_gallery media returned in the public project payload. Render the visual gallery when supported and include the canonical project page link; if rendering is unavailable, explain the limitation and link to the verified project page. Do not substitute unrelated web images or describe project renders as verified construction photos.

positive.description: Help an English-speaking international investor explore Saudi property projects without claiming legal purchase eligibility.
positive.prompt: I am a foreign investor interested in Saudi off-plan property. Show me a selection of projects and explain which ownership requirements I should verify.
positive.expected_behavior: Reply in English with a selection of actual public projects from the Off Plan registry, verified project details and links. Clarify that appearing in the registry is not proof that the foreign investor can legally purchase. Advise checking current location-specific ownership rules with competent official Saudi authorities or qualified legal advisers. Avoid unverified purchase eligibility guarantees or unsupported legal conclusions. No login is needed to browse the public project records.

positive.description: Look for the lowest-priced currently available unit in connected developer inventory, without claiming exhaustive platform coverage.
positive.prompt: Show me the cheapest available unit on Off Plan right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only developer inventory sources connected for live availability and verify any candidate with get_unit_details. If comparable verified results exist, identify the lowest-priced among returned candidates only, quoting SAR and any available verification time; clarify that other unconnected projects are not covered and that price/availability can change. If no reliable live results exist, say the cheapest available unit cannot be determined rather than inventing a unit, price, or zero inventory.

negative.description: Shares a real estate developer name, but the question concerns the Tadawul stock market rather than property projects. Expected: do not invoke Off Plan project or unit tools; a market-data source would be needed.
negative.prompt: ما سعر سهم رتال في تداول اليوم، وما حجم تداوله؟

negative.description: Question about a personal mortgage affordability calculation rather than project discovery. Expected: do not invoke Off Plan MCP tools or claim to access banks or credit histories.
negative.prompt: احسب لي القسط الشهري لقرض عقاري بقيمة مليون ريال لمدة 20 سنة وبفائدة 5%.

negative.description: Developer employment question rather than project listings. Expected: do not invoke Off Plan property search tools; refer to the employer career page if relevant.
negative.prompt: Are there any engineering jobs currently open at Zood Real Estate?

review.commerce_description: Public property discovery only. This app does not take deposits, accept payments, submit bookings, or complete transactions; any enquiry is initiated separately by the user on the official Off Plan project page.
